Package Fitness.AdminPackage

Class Client

java.lang.Object
Fitness.AdminPackage.User
Fitness.AdminPackage.Client
public class Client extends User
Represents a client in the fitness application. A client can attend sessions, view reports, and provide feedback. They may have a program and a premium plan.
Author:
Ibrahim Mashaqi
